config_lang_available: Last line of `atlas config lang`. $count is how many languages exist, $langs the list of tags.
config_lang_current: First line of `atlas config lang` with no argument. $lang is a language tag such as pt-BR.
config_lang_saved: Third line of `atlas config lang`: the preference saved in ~/.atlas/language. $lang is a tag.
config_lang_saved_none: Third line of `atlas config lang` when no preference is saved.
config_lang_set: Confirmation after `atlas config lang <tag>`. $lang is the saved tag.
config_lang_set_env_warning: Warning after `atlas config lang <tag>` when ATLAS_LANG is set: the saved language is not in effect in this shell. $value is the value of ATLAS_LANG.
config_lang_source: Second line of `atlas config lang`: which input decided the language. $source is one of the keys below. The environment variable and file names are literal and stay as they are.
config_lang_unsupported: Error when `atlas config lang <tag>` gets a language that has no catalog. $tag is what the user typed, $langs the list of valid tags.
